notes.title: Latest 1.0.8 Patch Note
notes.notes:
Dear Space Wanderers,

Thank you for your patience. We have been diligently addressing the issues that our players have encountered since the recent major update. Our team has worked tirelessly to resolve these problems and provide a smoother gaming experience. This latest update not only addresses several bugs but also includes adjustments to game difficulty. Our aim is to ensure that you have an enjoyable gaming experience. Please find below the details of the updates we have implemented.

Optimization:
● Prologue and Tower Climb: Optimized the stability of the prologue and tower climb to ensure a smooth gaming experience.

● Tutorial: To better guide our new players, we have added a 3-minute countdown that prompts whether to skip the tutorial after the countdown ends. This allows you to choose whether to participate in the full tutorial. Additionally, we simplified the shooting practice, requiring only a one shot to complete the tutorial, allowing you to quickly familiarize yourself with the game mechanics.

● Subtitle: Made significant adjustments to the subtitle box dialogue to ensure clear display of the conversation content.

● Ammo Box: Improved the control area of the ammo boxes for easier player interaction.

● Pico and Index Controller Positioning: Optimized the default controller positioning for Pico and Index devices.

● HTC VIVE Compatibility: When selecting the HTC VIVE headset model, a Steam VR settings recommendation will be displayed. Please follow the instructions to configure the settings for an enhanced gaming experience.

Bug Fixes:
● Settings Saving: Resolved the issue where settings would reset to default upon the second game launch after saving, ensuring proper saving and retention of settings.

● Drone Issue: Fixed the problem where drones didn't display feedback effects when receiving the last hit before dying, enabling clearer perception of the drone's status. Additionally, addressed the lack of electrical effects upon drone death, ensuring comprehensive and consistent visual effects.

● Frostbiter Soldier: Fixed the issue where liquid nitrogen remnants from a Frostbiter's death did not apply the slowing effect, ensuring the proper functionality of the freezing mechanic. Also fixed the sound effects.

● Upgrade Center Data Update Fix: Rectified the issue where upgrade center interface material data was not updated in real-time, allowing timely access to the latest upgrade information.

● Enemy Spawn: Addressed the problem of enemies spontaneously appearing in front of players, ensuring enemy appearances adhere to the game's logic and enhancing realism.

● Backpack Laser Cannon Activation Issue: Fixed the issue where flipping through the backpack would mistakenly trigger the laser cannon.

● Right Hand Laser Sword Activation Issue: Rectified the problem where releasing the right-hand laser sword would mistakenly trigger the laser cannon.

● Material Cabinet Judgment Anomaly: Fixed the issue with cabinet interactions, ensuring successful material acquisition and proper cabinet door opening.

● Revolver Attack Detection Fix: Addressed the issue of enemy hit detection with the revolver, increased the revolver's attack detection range, and improved the revolver's combat experience.

● Fifth-Floor Safe House Floor Height Fix: Resolved the abnormal floor height issue in the fifth-floor safe house.

● Enemy Death Floor Sinking Fix: Fixed the occasional issue where enemies would sink into the floor after death, improving scene stability.

● Arrow Penetration Issue: Fixed the issue where arrows had a chance to pass through enemies upon impact, resulting in no damage. 

● Enemy Close Range Attack Fix: Resolved the problem where enemies had a chance to be unable to damage players when in close proximity.

● Infiltrator Skill Fix: Fixed the issue where the drone showed no response when the player used the infiltrator skill.

Game Difficulty Adjustments:
● Laser Cannon Attack Distance: Increased the effective attack distance of the laser cannon against enemies, allowing long-range attacks.

● Weapon Unlocking: After reaching the base, you can now directly unlock all weapons without the need to collect materials for unlocking.

● Safe House Med Bay: To provide a better healing experience, the med bay in the safe house now has 
full capacity instead of one-third capacity, allowing for complete health recovery.

● Enemy Health Bar Display: Adjusted the display scale of enemy health bars to make them clearer and easier to read, providing better awareness of enemy health status.

● Buff Ampoules: Doubled the values of all buff ampoules to enhance their effects within the game.

● Flamethrower: Increased the explosion radius of dying flamethrowers, enabling damage to nearby enemies as well.

● Frostbiter: After the frostbiters explode upon death, they now slow down all other nearby enemies within the radius.

● Spider Robots: Increased the health valueof spider robots, making them more durable in combat.

● 3rd Floor: Slightly increased the number of enemies on the third floor.

● Spider Robots: Slightly improved the attack hit rate of spider robots against players.

● Drones: Enhanced the visual cues for drone attacks, allowing drones to detect players using the infiltrator skill.

Stay connected with us on all the latest game and hardware developments by joining our Discord community at https://discord.gg/HRpSjTYxem

Happy gaming!
The Wandering In Space Team

notes.title: Tips & Notes for the Performance Issue Regarding our Recent Major Update
notes.notes:
Dear wanderers,

Thank you for your support to our game and we are truly grateful for making this far. However, after our major update on June 19th, we became aware of certain performance issues encountered by our players. To address this problem, we are optimizing the game itself and providing a comprehensive setting guide to assist you in quickly addressing any debugging needs.

Furthermore, we would like to apologize to players who have encountered game crashes. As we completely rebuilt the game using UE5, the transition to the new system has introduced changes that may result in crashes or malfunctions for players who had previously downloaded "Wandering In Space." 

We are actively working on game optimizations, the best solution at this time is to uninstall the game and download it again. We apologize for any inconvenience caused by this process.

To ensure that every player enjoys smooth gameplay and resolves any performance-related challenges, we have prepared an all-inclusive setting guide. This guide caters specifically to Pico and Quest 2 headset users, as well as those utilizing SteamVR. 


For Quest 2 users: 
● Open App library and then click Virtual Desktop

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42338356/c084edc2251f5c21ec286cdb9acde15c3e2ffd28.png

● Adjust the resolution setting according to your graphics card or a similar model. Setting it too high on low configurations may lead to lag and latency issues.
● Different resolution settings will automatically adjust the corresponding bitrates, ensuring a smoother gaming experience.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42338356/1fc0c8ebeac0f545c07a3259d3c7db44ddf5b994.png

For Pico users:
● Adjust the resolution setting according to your graphics card or a similar model. Setting it too high on low configurations may lead to lag and latency issues.
● Different resolution settings will automatically adjust the corresponding bitrates, ensuring a smoother gaming experience.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42338356/39e012a5af942d54762c88a8b19446e69d82ef40.png

For SteamVR settings:
● Within the SteamVR settings, navigate to the "General" section and set the Render Resolution to "Auto." This allows the system to determine the optimal settings based on your PC environment.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42338356/4203f7c9bd252f1f65e6eb36daa1a54cf06e1fa8.png

● We advise against selecting "Manual" settings as it forces your PC to run at a specific resolution, potentially causing performance issues.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42338356/84f6a6c0d9264d64accdad05b1b3e60b74724f5d.png

If you are using a different type of headset and require assistance or updates, we warmly invite you to join our Discord community: https://discord.gg/HRpSjTYxem. Our dedicated team will provide technical support, keep you informed, and ensure that you have the best possible gaming experience.

Once again, we thank you for your love and support for our game. We remain committed to delivering continuous improvements in performance and providing you with a truly immersive VR gaming experience. Should you have any questions or feedback, please feel free to contact us.

notes.title: Wandering In Space Major Update Coming!
notes.notes:
Dear Space Wanderers,

It's our favorite season, and we can hardly believe it's been nearly a year since we launched our game. The response we've received has been overwhelming, and we're incredibly grateful for the attention and support from our amazing community.  Thank you all! 

We have exciting news to share: the highly anticipated remake of "Wandering In Space" will be released! We have taken all the valuable feedback and suggestions from our dedicated players and implemented numerous improvements to make this version even better.Enjoy the current version and get ready for our future updates, including more story-based missions, an an array of sleek and stylish space armors, and the exhilaration of open-world gameplay.

Here are some of the new features and fixes you can look forward to:

First of all, Wandering In Space is remade in Unreal Engine 5!

【New Contents】
● An improved experience to interact with game items! Instead of picking up materials and supplies randomly on the floor, we have created ammo boxes, potion supply boxes, and material collection cabinets in game. To collect ammos and supplies, interact with the boxes or open the combination lock.  
● Added left-hand support! Choose your preference in the main menu or at the start. 
● Added password-protected gates, which require entering the correct password to unlock and provide valuable materials or supplies.
● Trap mechanisms, including flamethrowers, machine guns, and laser cannons, have been added to floors 3, 4, 5, and 6.
● Three new exo-armor suits have been introduced: Predator, Overseer, and Infiltrator, each with different skills and attributes. Unlock them by completing 6 floors.
● The layout of safe house is changed, including the potion supply room and a material recycling machine that is moved to the side of elevator.
● Twelve new level maps have been added.
● More customization options, including turning and sound effects customization, are now available.
● Melee weapon Electric Blades are available for duel wielding 
● Physics simulation for storing bullets and revolvers at the waist.
● Zombie health bars have been added, with the option to toggle their visibility.

【Optimizations】
Enemy AI:
● Armed soldiers can now alternate between rifles and handguns, with added actions like sprinting and crouching. They can seek cover and engage in combat with players.
● Patrol and attack logic of flamethrowers and poison soldiers has been optimized, ensuring immediate engagement upon spotting players.
 Weak points for these enemies are added where attacking their fuel backpacks causes double damage.
● Killer drones have improved intelligence, seeking cover and retreating when low on health, as well as adjusting flight height in complex terrain.
● Regular zombies now have improved attack and patrol states, and a sound-based patrol and player search system has been added.

Visual Effects Optimization:
● Changed the color of blood splatters on zombies to light blue.
● Mutants, cyborgs, and bomber zombies now leave blood stains when hit.
● Fuel backpack soldiers and armed soldiers leave bullet hole marks when hit.
● Adjusted parameters for blackouts and lights-off situations in the game.
● Optimized attack effects of fuel backpack soldiers, armed soldiers, and killer drones.
● Reduced performance impact of flamethrowers' flame, ice, poison, and explosion effects.
● Optimized lag caused by explosive effects of toxic zombies and death smoke.
● Improved pistol sight angle.
● Enhanced visual feedback from killing zombies.
● Modified and optimized the game settings interface.
● Revamped the base upgrade interface, including character, armmory, and backpack upgrades.
● Modified the interface for unlocking weapons and crafting bullets, adding new weapon wall interface and bullet crafting interface.
● Improved logic capture of the weapon selection interface.
● Optimized viewing of potion buff values.
● Provided an option to skip the tutorial at the beginning.
● Added save function: Players can create and load save slots.

UI Interface Optimization:
● Modified and optimized the game settings interface.
● Revamped the base upgrade attribute interface, including character, firearms, and backpack upgrades.
● Modified the interface for unlocking weapons and crafting bullets, adding new weapon wall interface and bullet crafting interface.
● Improved logic capture of the weapon selection interface.
● Optimized viewing of potion buff values.
● Provided an option to skip the tutorial at the beginning instead of forcing players to go through it.
● Added save function: Players can create and load save slots with a limit on the number of saves.

Sound Effects Optimization:
● Optimized the sound of patrol, detection, attack, hit, and death sounds of zombies.
● Added spatial surround sound effects for zombies and environmental objects.

Levels and Map:
● Streamlined the beginner flow in the prologue, where players only need to complete the tutorial or choose to skip it to awaken in the hibernation pod.
● Lowered the overall difficulty of the prologue and optimized mission guidance.
● Modified the tower climbing process. After players teleport to the base for the first time, the base facilities will be in a blackout state. Players need to follow the arrow instructions to complete corresponding dialogue sequences, then go to the first, second, and third floors to obtain energy cores and return to the base to activate the corresponding facilities. After activating all three cores, players can officially start climbing the tower.

【Bug Fixes】
● Resolved the issue in the tutorial that prevented players from shooting during a two-handed grip. 
● Addressed the problem in the prologue where monsters only walked or jogged instead of running until the player collected the 393 samples.
● Rectified the issue of blurry text.
● Fixed the problem that prevented the menu from being accessed to view settings during tutorial levels.
● Fixed the effects of certain weapons when firing and hitting enemies
● Eliminated the occurrence of fuel backpack soldiers' effects passing through walls
● Resolved the issue of duplicate buffs.
● Fixed the blending of supply stations with the background.
● Corrected the abnormal brightness that occurred after adjusting game brightness settings.

Also the free demo of  is available! Now, click the link below to add the game into your library then invite your friends to join the new battlefield!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2301800/Online_VR/

We can't wait for you to dive into the revamped "Wandering In Space" and experience all the incredible updates we've made. Stay tuned for more exciting announcements as we approach the release date!
Stay connected with us on all the latest game and hardware developments by joining our Discord community at https://discord.gg/HRpSjTYxem. And our twitter is @WanderingInSpa1. We can't wait to share exciting news and provide exclusive sneak peeks to our valued players. 

Happy gaming!
The Wandering In Space Team

notes.title: Latest 1.0.7 Patch Note
notes.notes:
Hello my fellow space wanderers, 

It's been a while since we had major updates last time. As some of you might know, the PVE &PVP production is going full speed ahead. While we are occupied in delivering new contents, it is also our priority to make sure all the current feedback and suggestions are properly addressed. 

If you are new to the space, feel like to provide any feedback or just want to chill, please Join us on Discord! https://discord.gg/2frVXpSP55 Our community has been growing and new bloods are always welcomed, especially for the upcoming PVE mode. 

New Content

    A tutorial is added to the demo,
    The initial state of the weapon is upgraded by 50% to provide beginners with better combat experiences.

Optimization 

General UI interface

    The aiming circle is expanded and a crosshair is added for assistance;
    Game setting has been optimized: the selected status will no longer show "turn on/off", Once the corresponding option is selected, the selection box will turn green.
    Snap turning and smooth turning function has been optimized. 
    The arrow color is changed to be more noticeable, especially for the elevator. 
    The dialogue from AI has been optimized. 
    In the upgrade center, backpack upgrade label is changed from "auxiliary upgrade" to "backpack upgrade".
    Changed magazines color   to "white".
    Added status UI to the teaching level panel.

Game Art

    The scene texture is optimized to avoid potential mapping issues.  
    Adjusted scene exposure 
    Weakened burst effect after killing enemies, plasma colour changed to dark red.

Weapon and Buff System

    The crosshair front sight of revolver is optimized for better aiming. 
    When the invisibility skill (infiltrator) is activated, the weapon with hand would also be invisible.
    Infiltrator skill consumption increased by 30%.

Optimized the BUFF system UI 

    All the buffs have been classified to "common", "rare" and "epic" with corresponding colors to indicate their values. 
    Optimized the description with its buff name
    Adjusted BUFF display clarity.
    Optimized the buff "twice the rewards" so it the buff takes effect immediately after being selected.
    Reinforcement machine UI changed from "X 15%" to "+15%"
    Adjusted BUFF UI display, now only shows icons and doubles the size of the icons.

Others

    Reduced the level difficulty when entering the 3rd floor by reducing high-level enemies, however the numbers of enemies remain unchanged.
    Enemy distance adjustment after resurrection.
    Reading messages is no longer required in order to proceed. 
    The default backpack capacity has been increased from 1 page to 2 pages.
    20% more ammunition resupply for the 5th floor museum.
    50% more blood for training targets in the training range and tutorial.

Bug Fixes

    Fixed UAV killer model display failure.
    Fixed the issue when activating the invisibility skill,  the left-hand remains visible. 
    Fixed the issue of unable to proceed the commander messages after clearing the level for the first time.
    Fixed the predetor skill failure caused by inadequet operation.
    Fixed the loading of enemy textures to ensure better combat experiences.


That's all! We hope you enjoy the update and game demo. More info around PVE alpha test would come soon! 

Wandering In Space Team

notes.title: The first update is complete!
重要的更新！Important update!
notes.notes:
The fixes include:  

1, improve the total amount of oxygen;  (So players don't have to worry about finding oxygen frequently)  

2, add "Settings" menu to meet different personality options;  (The player will be free to set fast or smooth movement, rotation orientation and method, etc.)  

3. Optimize the sensitivity of picking up magazines and backpacks;  (More accurate handling of magazines and backpacks)  

4. Add the record point of "prologue" at the beginning of the new game;  (Death will no longer start from the beginning, but directly from the nearest dormancy module)  

5. Optimize the ununified translation of some subtitles to ensure that all subtitles have different languages;  (We will ensure the translation of all the parts corresponding to different languages that are not fully translated in the opening part, story subtitle and other parts)  

6. Optimized gun holding Angle for HTC and INDEX players with high handle direction;  (We will have special options to make the gun Angle more natural and accurate for HTC and INDEX players)  

7. Modify the weapon holding mechanism. Press and release the side holding button only when grabbing or putting back the weapon.  (For HTC and INDEX players, the weapon will suddenly disappear due to misoperation when the controller is no longer in use)  

The above modifications are only a small part of our recent work, we will continue to listen to every player's comments and feedback, continue to improve the game, and do our best to make every player have a pleasant experience!  Thank you again for your understanding, patience and support! 
修复内容包括：
1、提高氧气的总量；（这样玩家将不用再为高频率的寻找氧气而困扰）
2、增加“设置”菜单满足不同个性的选项；（玩家将可以自由设置快速或平滑移动、旋转的朝向和方式等）
3、优化拿取弹夹和背包的灵敏度；（拿取弹夹和取出背包的操作准确率将更高）
4、增加新游戏开头“序章”的记录点；（死亡之后将不会从最开始开始，而是最近的休眠舱直接开始）
5、优化未统一翻译的部分字幕，确保所有字幕都有对应不同的语言文字；（片头故事字幕等部分未完全翻译对应各国文字的部分我们将确保他们全部对应翻译）
6、针对htc和index玩家手柄方向偏高的问题优化持枪的角度；（我们将设置专门的选项让htc和index玩家的持枪角度更加自然准确）
7、修改武器握持机制，只有抓取或放回武器时需要按压并松开侧握键，其他时间都不用一直保持按压状态。（对于htc和index玩家的手柄不在会出现误操作而让武器突然消失）
以上部分优化修改只是我们近期工作的一小部分，我们将继续认真倾听每一个玩家的意见和反馈，持续不断的改良游戏，尽我们最大的努力让每位玩家都得到愉快的体验！再次感谢大家对我们的理解、耐心于支持！！
